title: Great - most of the time
text: I have used SimplyWise for many years and have found it extremely helpful - but only when I have the receipt. I have struggled with the recurring option, as it does not always “recur.” It also boasts of an interface with Amazon, but it is clunky at best. No option to select dates - only of years. Needs to be continually re-synced. Overall OK - but could be improved on.

title: Expensive export
text: I think this is probably great if you’re a business. And the core functionality is solid (scanning etc). Not a subscription option that won’t let me export is really frustrating. They really push that vendor lock-in. Feels sleazy.

title: Frustrating updates and internet requirements
text: Why should I need to be connected to the internet to be able to save a receipt? Also, why should I need to update the app so often and be forced to do so even when I dont have good internet service? This app really doesnt work well if you dont have continuous internet service at all times. And on top of that the offline receipt saving function fails. Now I have 2 unsaved offline receipts that I cannot access. What items am I not going to be reimbursed for?

title: Update made it worse
text: Recent updates made the receipt scanner worse.  Even on high contrast background it had a hard time finding the edges.  It picked the wrong amount from the receipt for the total.  It wouldn’t let me select the tax amount that it totally missed.

title: Great at scanning receipts, Awful at reconciling
text: It is very cool how well this app reads receipts although it doesn’t do great at handwriting so if you go to a restaurant and add a tip, you have to edit. If the app sold itself as just a depository of receipts, that would be fine. I could then go through my bank account manually and reconcile transactions however, it claims to have a reconciliation function. But it is awful. When you connect your bank account and click on a transaction, the program suggests a receipt you can either say yes or no, but you cannot search through your database to find the correct receipt, nor can you reconcile from the receipt database. And the suggestions are ridiculously wrong. Often the merchant date and amount don’t match and for some reason it gets obsessed with suggesting the same receipt for every transaction even if you’ve already reconciled that receipt to a transaction.
